name: Dumbbell Hammer Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms supported on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, thumbs up.
Bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower both dumbbells gradually until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms on the pad as the dumbbells rise.
Keep your wrists neutral and stop just short of locking your elbows at the bottom.
